name: Counsel workspace
description: Free, self-hosted legal workspace for contract review, legal research, drafting, workflows and matter collaboration. Apache 2.0. No hosted service, seat fee, telemetry or mandatory model API.

pricing.notes: No hosted service or seat fee. The operator pays for hardware and for any optional model provider.

requirements.docker: optional; Docker Engine with Compose v2 for the supplied team deployment

capabilities: Personal mode with loopback-only access and synthetic seed data
Team mode with owner, editor, viewer and guest roles
Argon2 password hashing, revocable sessions, CSRF and origin checks, rate limits
Matters and PDF, DOCX, TXT, Markdown and CSV import
Original-file retention and page and paragraph anchors
Matter-scoped ranked passage search and deterministic clause anchors
Review tables with evidence inspection, locks, filters and CSV export
Document comparisons, highlighted changes and DOCX revision export
Rich-text drafting with comments, checkpoints, proposed edits and DOCX export
Versioned workflow templates, approval gates, retries, cancellation and schedules
Intake tracking, document monitors and follow-up tasks
Guest-only client portal with explicit publication and immediate revocation
US Federal Register research and eCFR imports with publication watches
Signed webhook, Slack and Microsoft Teams notifications with durable receipts
Checksummed matter archives with an offline verifier
Owner-only archive restore with fail-closed collision handling and an explicit no-side-effects policy
MCP integration with expiring and revocable keys
Optional local Ollama, OpenAI-compatible, Anthropic and OpenAI generation
Docker Compose deployment, online backup and restore guidance
optionalIntegrations: MCP hosts such as Codex and Claude Code
exclusions: No provider ACL or ethical-wall synchronization
No archive encryption, signature or notarization
Archive restore is owner-only and never resumes execution: jobs, schedules, watches and audit rows restore per the documented side-effect policy
No independent security audit or penetration test
No blinded legal-quality comparison with Legora or any commercial product
No live Slack or Microsoft Teams tenant acceptance
Not legal advice and no attorney-client relationship

verification.ci: GitHub Actions: tests, build, format check, dependency audit, Docker build and hardened-container smoke test

retrievalBenchmark.notes: Designed alongside the implementation; not held-out evidence.

clauseEvaluation.notes: Small sample. The validation partition has been inspected and is no longer fresh. Not a legal-accuracy guarantee.
